founder_chairman.name: Er. Sapan Kumar Padhy
founder_chairman.message: Dear Parent / Student, no stone will remain unturned from our side to make a smooth path for you to fulfil your dreams. BSET had a humble beginning in 2004 and has grown into a premier technical education institution in South Odisha. Go ahead with your dreams, achieve them, and see that the world will follow you.

principal.name: Er. Lalitendu Sahu
principal.message: In the present scenario of globalization the fittest will only survive. In this global village, one has to be fully equipped with thorough knowledge of advanced techniques and high moral values. BSET is committed to nurturing energetic, effective, and efficient professionals ready to lead Indian and global industries.

departments.name: Civil Engineering
departments.overview: Civil engineering encompasses the planning, design, execution, and preservation of vital structures and infrastructure, requiring strong technical expertise as well as supervisory and administrative skills.
highlights: Consultancy services provided to Government and Private Sector companies
Advanced surveying and material testing equipment
Regular site visits and live construction project exposure

departments.name: Electrical Engineering
departments.overview: Produces diploma engineers with strong fundamentals in electrical power systems, machines, power electronics, transmission, and modern industrial automation.
highlights: Fully equipped AC/DC Machine Labs and Substation Simulation
Industrial seminar sessions with power grid engineers
Proctorial mentorship and comprehensive lecture notes support

departments.name: Electronics & Telecommunication Engineering
departments.overview: Curriculum focused on Embedded Systems, VLSI Technologies, Wireless & Mobile Communications, and modern microprocessors.
highlights: Classrooms equipped with LCD projectors and cloud digital tools
Guest lectures and R&D workshops from industry experts

departments.name: Mechanical Engineering
departments.overview: Covers operation of modern machines, manufacturing processes, heat power engineering, machine design, automobile engineering, and materials management.
highlights: State-of-the-art workshops for lathe, welding, fitting, and foundry
Direct pathway for B.Tech lateral entry (2nd year) through entrance tests
Excellent placement record in automobile and machine tool industries

admission.eligibility: Pass in 10th Standard (Matriculation) or equivalent examination from a recognized board.
admission.procedure: Merit-based admission through D.T.E.&T. Odisha counseling and DET ranking system.
admission.application_cycle: Application forms available starting March every year.
admission.lateral_entry: ITI / +2 Science passed candidates eligible for Direct 2nd Year admission.
required_documents: Original College Leaving Certificate (CLC) / School Leaving Certificate (SLC) & Conduct Certificate
Original 10th / Matriculation Marksheet & Certificate with attested xerox copies
Original Caste Certificate for SC/ST/OBC candidates
3 Passport size & 2 Stamp size recent photographs
Aadhaar Card Copy and Residential Certificate
